methods.label: Find the difference
methods.levelReason: Finding the difference between two counts within 100 is within Grade 3 scope.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The target is the additive comparison represented by the difference. The retained equation does not demonstrate the written procedure in cnm_p034. cnm_p009 is restricted to numbers within 10, and cnm_p035 describes part-total relationships rather than this stated comparison, so neither is forced onto the method.

needsNewNodes.name: Exact whole-number subtraction within 100, independent of algorithm
needsNewNodes.description: Compute a nonnegative difference of whole numbers within 100 using any valid strategy, including interpreting a difference as how many more in a comparison problem, without prescribing column subtraction.
needsNewNodes.reason: The catalog lacks a route-neutral subtraction target covering these two-digit counts and their additive comparison.
